defects.defect: word/document.xml has four empty w:drawing elements. Each is the only child of mc:Choice Requires="wps", inside mc:AlternateContent, inside a w:r, with no mc:Fallback. One is enough for Word to report an open error. Deleting the element and leaving the AlternateContent opens clean. A w:drawing that contains wp:anchor is not this cause.
defects.change: Delete only the empty w:drawing element.

defects.defect: The package contains [trash]/0000.dat. [Content_Types].xml has no Override for that part and no Default for the dat extension. One undeclared part is enough for Word to offer recovery. An extra part that the xml Default already covers opens clean, so an unreferenced relationship is not the cause.
defects.change: Delete the [trash]/0000.dat part.

defects.defect: word/document.xml has two w:tr elements with no w:tc descendant. Each is <w:tr w:rsidR="001E515F"><w:trPr><w:gridBefore w:val="5" /></w:trPr></w:tr>. One such row is enough for Word to report an open error. Removing only w:gridBefore and leaving the row still errors. Inserting one <w:tc><w:p/></w:tc> into that row, and changing nothing else, opens clean. The first two rows of the same table each open clean. An empty body opens clean, so styles, settings, headers, footers, and the attached template are not the cause.
defects.change: Delete both rows. Adding a w:tc to each row also opens clean.

defects.defect: The package contains [trash]/0000.dat and [trash]/0001.dat. [Content_Types].xml has no Override for either part and no Default for the dat extension. One undeclared part is enough for Word to offer recovery. The hyperlink rId10 is an external hyperlink and is not this cause.
defects.change: Delete both [trash]/0000.dat and [trash]/0001.dat.

defects.defect: word/footer1.xml contains a VML text box, v:textbox inside w:pict, with one w:delText and one w:delInstrText. Either element alone makes Word offer recovery. A text box that contains only field characters opens clean. The document body contains 10018 w:delText elements and is not this cause: deleting only that pict opens the original clean. The footer reference rId7 is a real footer relationship. Pointing it at footer2.xml opens clean because that footer has no deleted text in a text box. A w:del on the paragraph mark is not the cause.
defects.change: Delete the w:pict in word/footer1.xml. Removing the w:delText and the w:delInstrText from its text box also opens clean.

defects.defect: Body child 22 is a paragraph with one mc:AlternateContent. Its mc:Choice is a drawingML wps:txbx whose w:txbxContent contains 25 w:delText elements. They remain in the repair, and Word opens clean.
defects.change: Inside both w:txbxContent elements, change w:delText to w:t. Removing only the VML text box leaves the drawingML copy and Word still warns. Removing only the Choice leaves the VML copy and Word still warns.
